On C-003, the plan commits to stdlib-only imports (os, shutil, json, datetime, pathlib), so no undeclared dependency arises. On C-001/C-004, the plan commits to typed errors and type hints on every signature. No secrets appear (C-006). Scope is a single coherent topic, chain retirement for issue #23 (C-002). No constraint is violated by the creation of this document.
